title: should render gate phase with URL, Name inputs and disabled buttons
verifies: gate phase renders with URL input, name input, back link, and disabled Record and Build buttons

title: should validate gate URL — show error on invalid, enable buttons on valid
verifies: gate URL validation shows error on invalid input and enables both buttons on a valid URL

title: should transition to extension-setup phase after clicking "Record Journey"
verifies: clicking Record Journey from the gate phase transitions to the extension setup checklist when no extension is detected

title: should skip extension setup via "Build Manually" and go directly to editor phase
verifies: clicking Build Manually bypasses extension setup and goes directly to the journey editor step

title: should transition to editor phase after clicking "Skip for now"
verifies: clicking Skip for now from the extension setup phase transitions to the editor phase

title: should show Step 3 dimmed initially and un-dim after incognito toggle
verifies: Step 3 (Connect) renders with opacity-60 before incognito toggle and without it after toggling

title: should keep "Open Recorder" disabled even after incognito toggle (no extension)
verifies: Open Recorder button stays disabled even after incognito switch is toggled on, because extensionReady is always false without a real Chrome extension

title: should open Chrome Web Store in new tab when Install button is clicked
verifies: clicking the Install button opens a new browser tab pointing to a URL

title: should open extension setup dialog from Journey Record button
verifies: clicking Record in the journey toolbar opens the extension setup dialog modal with a disabled primary button

title: should open extension setup dialog from Journey Replay button
verifies: clicking Replay in the journey toolbar opens the extension setup dialog modal with a disabled primary button

title: should keep dialog primary button disabled after incognito toggle (no extension)
verifies: toggling incognito inside the dialog does not enable the primary button because the extension is never connected

title: should persist incognito toggle state across dialog close/reopen
verifies: incognito toggle state set in the dialog survives closing and reopening the dialog

title: should show loading state on Record button during extension probe
verifies: the Record button enters a disabled loading state during probeExtension before transitioning to the extension setup phase
